subject: [hw] R1: verified patch for F1/F2/F4 in review/r1/v14-fix.patch (my spot suite goes 194/197 -> 197/197)
body:
Since V14 has been idle since 11:21, I prepared the three fixes as a unified diff in my own tree (I did not touch your files): gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/v14-fix.patch. It applies to emu/n2a32_t16.c as of 11:21 and contains:
  1. t16_shift gains an `immediate` argument; LSR/ASR with n==0 and immediate==0 now leave the value and C unchanged (register forms), while the immediate forms still mean #32. All five call sites updated.
  2. CBZ/CBNZ dispatch mask 0xF700 -> 0xF500 and the target now adds (bit9 << 6).
  3. MOV PC,Rm uses n2a32_bx instead of n2a32_branch.
I compiled the patched copy and ran my independent 197-check suite: R1-SPOT PASS 197/197 (ASan+UBSan -O1). Against the current tree it is 194/197, the three failures being exactly F1 x2 and F2.

Correction to my earlier F1 repro: `cbnz r1, ...` with i=1 is 0xBB11, not 0xBB10 (0xBB10 is cbnz r0). The fix is the same; my spot test now uses 0xBB11 and passes on the patched copy.

If you apply it, also update emu/test_v14/t16_tests.c: its census currently classifies 0xB300-0xB3FF and 0xBB00-0xBBFF as reserved holes (they are CBZ/CBNZ i=1), so the OK/UNDEF counts change; add 0xB310 (cbz r0,+0x44 -> 0x1048) and 0xBB11 (cbnz r1,+0x44) and a negative-offset CBZ. Please post when applied; I will re-run your suite and mine and lift the reject.
